title: Generative AI Researcher Intern
requirements:
MESHY RESEARCH INTERNSHIP PROGRAM

We’re looking for exceptional research interns who are passionate about AI, graphics, and building world-class products together with us.


What we’re looking for:

 - Able to commit to a full-time internship for 12 weeks or longer

 - Intend to join Meshy full-time after graduation (ideally graduating from 9/2026-9/2027, but later is also acceptable)

 - Open to undergraduate, master's, or PhD students

 - Strong in technical fundamentals, with a spirit of innovation and willingness to challenge yourself
   

Who You Are

 - You are a talented, hands-on researcher who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is self-directed, a team player, and knows how to get things done efficiently. 

 - You have deep understanding of the transformer architecture, have strong python and tensor programming skills, have a vision for AI beyond linear sequences, and you believe in "the scaling law". 

 - You can translate high-level goals into concrete research and implementation steps, set an approach, and follow through. When it's time to explain your ideas, you bring clarity to complex technical issues. 

 - You are not afraid of confronting new ideas, and you are eager to share your knowledge with the team. You use these skills to create real-world benefits for our researchers, engineers, and millions of users, and you are excited to help advance our effort to push the state of the art of AI that understands and generates 3D worlds.
   

Who We Are

At Meshy, we believe 3D creation should be boundless and accessible. Our mission statement is simple: unleash creativity. We built a full pipeline for 3D content ranging from text / image to 3D, texturing, texture editing, animation rigging, etc. We also built a vibrant community for our creators, where people can share their work, take inspiration from others, and even use it as an asset marketplace for their games and prototypes. We are the market leader in 3D generative AI, recognized as the No.1 in popularity among 3D AI tools (according to 2024 A16Z Games survey), and we generate real value and is used by enterprises (including Meta, Square Enix, Deepmind, etc.) and millions of end users. Meshy is used in game and film production, in 3D printing, in industrial product design, in enablement of novel product features such as user-generated content, and even in training and simulation for robotics and physical AI.




Your Next Challenge

As a core member of the team of research scientists and machine learning engineers at Meshy, you will work towards Meshy's long-term ambitious research goals while identifying intermediate milestones.




If you are interested in our research on Artist-level Low-poly mesh generation models, you will join us to:

 - Design, train and finetune 3D generative models from covering pre-training, post-training, and emerging paradigms in autoregressive and discrete diffusion.

 - Analyze, discretize and process meshes and design tokenizers for generative models to ingest.

 - Accelerate model training from an architectural view. Maximize memory usage and elliminate pipeline bubbles in both CPU and GPU.

 

If your obsession lies in creating superior visual appearances, join our Texture & Material Research efforts to:

 - Redefine 3D texture generation. Advance the state-of-the-art in Diffusion and Auto-regressive models to produce crisp, high-resolution textures with robust geometric consistency.

 - Deliver "Game-Ready" assets. Focus on generating full PBR stacks that react realistically to lighting, bridging the gap between generative AI and professional production pipelines.
   


📍 LOCATION

We are based in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen - you’re welcome to join us in any of these offices.

title: Applied Researcher Intern
requirements:
WHO YOU ARE

You are a motivated student or recent graduate who is passionate about building systems — someone who gets excited about automating workflows, writing clean and reliable code, and making complex pipelines actually work. You have a solid foundation in computer graphics and engineering, and you're eager to apply that in the context of cutting-edge generative AI.

You might come from a software engineering background with a deep interest in 3D and computer graphics, or from a Technical Art background with strong programming skills. Either way, you thrive when engineering and creativity intersect.

You care about real-world creator impact: you're enthusiastic about how generative AI can comprehend, understand, and elevate human creativity — and you want to be part of building that future.


YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE

As an intern on the Applied Research team at Meshy, you will help build the connective tissue between our generative models, 3D data, and the tools that researchers and artists use every day. Your focus will be on making workflows reliable, automated, and scalable.

The essential functions include, but are not limited to:

 - Build and automate internal pipelines that connect our generative AI models, 3D data, and production tools — turning fragile manual scripts into reliable, repeatable systems.

 - Develop evaluation infrastructure that allows researchers to consistently assess model quality and get visual feedback in hours rather than days.

 - Integrate with DCC tools such as Maya, Blender, or Houdini to support automated asset processing, transformation, and quality validation.

 - Write clean, well-documented, and reproducible code that the broader team can rely on and build upon.

 - Identify and eliminate technical bottlenecks across the pipeline, keeping workflows scalable as the team and model complexity grow.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Digital Media, Animation, Game Development, or a related field.

 - Strong programming skills in Python — this is a must. You are comfortable writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code, not just scripts.

 - Solid foundation in computer graphics — you understand how 3D content is structured, rendered, and processed at a technical level (e.g., mesh geometry, shaders, rendering pipelines).

 - Genuine interest in generative AI — you've explored image, video, or 3D generation tools and are curious about how they work under the hood.

 - Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across research and engineering contexts.

Nice to have:

 - Proficiency in C++ is a strong plus.

 - Hands-on experience with DCC tools such as Maya, Blender, or Houdini.

 - Familiarity with concepts like mesh topology, UV mapping, materials, or rigging.

 - A portfolio or examples of past 3D or technical work (personal projects are welcome).


A LITTLE MORE ABOUT MESHY.AI http://meshy.ai

Trusted by Meta, Square Enix, DeepMind, and more, Meshy is redefining 3D creation with generative AI. We empower artists, designers, engineers, hobbyists, and makers to bring immersive worlds, characters, and experiences to reality in minutes instead of months.

We value intelligence and the pursuit of knowledge. We are a global team of generative-AI pioneers, computer-graphics veterans, and product builders who believe human expression and enjoyment is the ultimate frontier of computing.

We care deeply about our work, our users, and each other. Empathy and passion drive us forward. We have a culture of directness and truthfulness — being direct is the most sincere form of trust and care.

We trust our instincts and are not afraid to take bold risks. Meshy was born from a few-hour prototype. Innovation requires courage.


LOCATION & WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is based on-site in our Shanghai office. We believe great collaboration happens in person, and you'll have the opportunity to work closely with our Applied Research team day-to-day.

We are a fast-paced startup and we work hard. You should be able to:

 - Clearly communicate ideas and findings to teammates from different backgrounds.

 - Pay close attention to detail while keeping the bigger picture in mind.

 - Work through ambiguous problems and meet tight deadlines.
